transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, yeah, my new streaming box keeps freezing and buffering every few minutes, it's basically unwatchable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I get your account number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. Is it wired or WiFi.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: WiFi, same as my old one which worked fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: New devices sometimes just do that at first.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's been happening every single day for a week though.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah that happens.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there something specific you can check?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Try restarting it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've restarted it probably ten times already.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Try again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, restarting now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright, restarted, still buffering right away.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Huh.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is my internet plan even fast enough for 4K? Nobody explained that when I bought this thing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Should be fine, most plans are.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you actually check my plan speed instead of guessing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I don't really have that pulled up right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is honestly pretty frustrating, I paid a lot for this box and it just doesn't work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah well new devices can be like that sometimes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's not really addressing what I said.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I hear you. Anyway, is the box near the router or far?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's in the living room, router's in the office, maybe twenty feet away, two walls.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's probably it then, WiFi doesn't travel great through walls.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It never had this problem with my old box in the same spot though.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Different devices, different antennas, that's normal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay well what am I supposed to do about it then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You could move it closer I guess.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The living room is where the TV is, I can't move the TV.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Then I don't really know what to tell you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you get your account number again, did you even pull up my account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I get your account number again, sorry?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 774-201-558, I already gave you that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, okay.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there a signal booster or extender you guys sell, something like that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There might be, I'd have to check with sales, not really my department.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You're support though, can't you just look into it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's more of a sales thing honestly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So you can't help with this at all?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not really, no.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is really not what I expected from a support call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry you feel that way.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there literally anything else to try before I just give up?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You could try a wired connection if the box supports it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It does actually, let me check where the nearest ethernet jack is.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There isn't one in the living room, only in the office.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Then WiFi's your only option really.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So basically nothing can be done.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sounds like it, yeah.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you at least note on my account that this box has never worked properly since I got it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can put something on there I guess.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do, I don't want to have to explain all this again next time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fine, noting it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there a way to test if it's actually a bandwidth issue versus a device issue?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not something I can really check from here.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What can you check exactly, at this point?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just basic account stuff mostly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, this whole call has been pretty useless honestly, no offense.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: None taken I guess.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there a supervisor or someone else who might actually know more about this?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You could call back another time maybe.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's not really an answer either.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's the best I've got.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. Is there at least a signal strength number I could look at myself on the box?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Probably somewhere in its settings menu, I'm not totally sure where.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'll poke around myself I guess.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Found a network settings screen, it says signal strength fair, forty percent.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's probably your issue then.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You said that about the wall distance already too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could be both I guess.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This isn't very reassuring.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's just streaming, it's not the end of the world.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's the end of the world that I paid for a service that doesn't work, yeah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fair enough I suppose.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there any kind of credit for the week this has been broken?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's billing, not something I handle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you transfer me then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You'd have to call that number separately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Of course I would.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Honestly at this point I don't even know what to try next.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Maybe try a mesh WiFi setup down the road.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is that something you all sell or install?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Might be, not sure, again more of a sales thing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything's apparently a sales thing today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Pretty much.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is the box itself even fully updated, could that be part of it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could be, I can't check firmware from my screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So basically you can't check anything today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Basically, yeah, sorry.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright. At this point I'll just deal with it myself I guess.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Probably for the best honestly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's a weird thing for support to say but okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just being real with you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure. Is there anything at all you can do before we end this call?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not really, I've told you what I can.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Which wasn't much, but alright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Noted, I guess.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. I'll figure it out on my own then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good luck with it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks, I guess. That's everything on my end.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually wait, one more thing, does the box even have a warranty I could use instead?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Probably, not something I check.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Who would check that then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Maybe the store you bought it from.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I bought it directly from you guys though.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Then maybe billing again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything keeps going back to billing or sales today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's kind of how the departments split up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Seems like support doesn't actually do much then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We handle what we handle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there at least a ticket number for this call so I'm not starting from zero next time?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Should generate one automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you read it to me so I have it written down?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I don't see it on my screen yet, it usually shows up after.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Convenient.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not really my system, just how it works.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there anything I should try tonight versus waiting for a callback?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Restarting again I guess, or the wired option if you ever get a jack run out there.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Running a new ethernet line sounds like a whole project just to watch TV.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah probably.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This has honestly been one of the most unhelpful calls I've had with any company.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry you feel that way, some days are just like this.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's not really on me though, is it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Didn't say it was.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright, I really do need to go at this point.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sounds good.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks, I guess. That's everything on my end.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net.
